name: path-navigator
description: Quickly open files or reveal directories by searching their workspace-relative paths.

pathNavigator.maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching files and directories shown in the picker.

pathNavigator.showFiles.description: Show file results in the picker.

pathNavigator.showDirectories.description: Show directory results in the picker. Disable this for a file-only quick opener.

pathNavigator.fuzzyMatching.description: Allow non-contiguous fuzzy matches after exact, prefix, and substring matches.

enumDescriptions: Pressing Enter reveals the directory in Explorer.
Pressing Enter enters the directory and continues searching inside it.
pathNavigator.directoryAction.description: Action performed when Enter accepts a directory result. Tab always enters the directory.

enumDescriptions: Show only the containing directory beside each result.
Hide path descriptions. Multi-root workspaces still show the workspace name.
pathNavigator.resultPathDisplay.description: Controls how paths are displayed beside result names.

pathNavigator.freezeResultsOnNavigation.description: Freeze the visible result snapshot before keyboard or mouse navigation so background updates cannot move the selection.

pathNavigator.progressiveSearchResults.description: Publish intermediate search snapshots. Disabled by default so each query updates the candidate list atomically when its bounded search completes.

pathNavigator.keepOpenOnFocusLost.description: Keep the Path Navigator picker open when focus moves to another part of VS Code.

pathNavigator.showStatusPrompt.description: Show indexing, searching, paused, and result-limit information above the candidate list.

pathNavigator.maxIndexEntries.description: Maximum number of workspace paths retained in the index. Set to 0 for no limit. The picker reports when this limit is reached.

pathNavigator.indexConcurrency.description: Maximum number of workspace directories read concurrently while indexing. Lower this for high-latency or resource-constrained remote workspaces.

pathNavigator.autoRefreshIndex.description: Automatically apply incremental index updates after files or directories are created or deleted.

pathNavigator.incrementalUpdateBatchLimi.description: Maximum number of coalesced file-system events handled incrementally. Larger event storms trigger a full rebuild.

enumDescriptions: Use the portable VS Code workspace file-system API and include empty directories.
Try Git, fd, and ripgrep in order, then fall back to the workspace file-system API.
Use git ls-files and derive directories. Ignored and empty directories are omitted.
Use fd for files and directories, falling back to the workspace file-system API when unavailable.
Use ripgrep for files and derive directories. Empty directories are omitted.
pathNavigator.indexingBackend.description: Backend used for full workspace indexing. External commands run in the local or remote workspace extension host and are disabled in untrusted workspaces.

pathNavigator.initialIndexDepth.description: Initial workspace.fs indexing depth. Set to 0 for a complete index. A positive value indexes shallow paths first and loads a subtree when you enter it.

pathNavigator.persistIndex.description: Persist a compressed workspace path index so results are available quickly after reopening the workspace.

pathNavigator.persistentIndexMaxAgeHours.description: Maximum age of a persistent path index in hours. Set to 0 to accept any age; background refresh can still validate it.

pathNavigator.refreshPersistentIndexInBa.description: Rebuild the index in the background after restoring persistent results to reconcile changes made while VS Code was closed.

pathNavigator.maxSearchCandidates.description: Maximum number of indexed paths scored by an expanded fuzzy search. One- and two-character searches use lower internal limits.

pathNavigator.searchTimeBudgetMs.description: Soft time budget in milliseconds for an expanded fuzzy search. Exact, prefix, and recent-path candidates are considered first.

pathNavigator.recentPathsLimit.description: Maximum number of recently and frequently opened workspace paths retained locally for ranking. Set to 0 to disable history.

pathNavigator.excludeDirectoryNames.description: Directory names that are excluded from the path index.

pathNavigator.excludeFileExtensions.description: File extensions or suffixes excluded from the index, for example [".log", "map", ".test.ts"].

pathNavigator.openFilesInPreview.description: Open selected files as preview editors instead of pinned tabs.
